display_information.description: Run, monitor, and review autonomous engineering workflows from Slack.
display_information.long_description: auto-swe wires LLM agents through a configurable workflow DAG to ship code: implement, review, gate, merge, PR. The Slack app surfaces /auto-swe workflows list/show, the /auto-swe run modal for kicking off a work request, and per-step failure + final-status notifications threaded back to the originating channel.
